name: FJPW Saturday Night CHAOS #1

date.source: Both held parts are dated 2 November 1997.

notes: The fed's own first full show, billed at least four parts long; only Part I (the opening interview segment and Match #1) and Part IV (the Match #6 main event) are in the held record. Matches #2-5 are not held and are not structured.

matches.note: Billed as a tag match against Blaine Idol and Brian Fields, but Fields never appeared (commentary blames a mid-show medical emergency), leaving Idol to face the Lion's Den alone.

Main event. Starbuck won by schoolboy cradle after Mike Madland and Tommy Van Dam, both guest stars, brawled into the cage; Madland struck Cooper with a china plate before Van Dam knocked Madland off the cage with a flying body press.

name: FJPW Blood, Sweat, and Tears

date.source: Billed to run 14-17 November 1997; no more specific date is given for the special attraction match below.

evidence.note: The fed's own final card preview, 26 October 1997, billing a Mike Madland vs. Tommy Van Dam special attraction match, an E-1 Tournament bracket (unnamed entrants), and an Icon Tag Team title battle royal. No results document for this event survives in the held record.

notes: The promised E-1 Invitational tournament final and the Icon Tag Team title battle royal are billed in the same preview but name no confirmed entrants beyond seed numbers and are not structured here.
